title: Static44 packing ceiling: less than 0.000399% kappa headroom
body:
**Scoped negative result: no improved κ is claimed.** For #544's fixed static44 complex word, nine-stage chain, eight replicas, helper widths and inherited bad-class charge, every whole-helper packing in the stated model has **b < 0.001593251957517**. Even an optimistic fractional pool that ignores chronology and ownership cannot reach that endpoint.

The retained balanced conversion then gives **κ < 0.001590717543676681**. Relative to #547's pinned `079c86cd4a0667506f4d75e0d2584a51a481a3bb` checkpoint, **0.001590711200057236**, all remaining packing headroom is **less than 6.344e-9**, or **0.000399%**. The subsequently updated #547 adopts a changed #548 complex word and is outside this fixed-word bound. This identifies a limit of further owner-map/schedule tuning for this fixed word; changed circuits, widths, chains, banks, bad-class charges and outer proofs remain outside the bound.

The package derives idle stock and helper demand from pinned #544 artifacts, enumerates every relaxed pattern, and verifies a seven-weight rational dual. Two independent moment engines must each establish every pattern inequality and a strictly positive exclusion margin, including the retained per-child fallback charge. The already-admitted rate and an inflated dual weight must reject as negative controls. A floating LP only nominated the vector; the verifier imports no optimizer.

```sh
python -B research/static44-packing-ceiling/verify.py /absolute/new/receipt.json
```

Standard library only; no network or solver. Complete macOS/Python 3.14.8 and Linux/Python 3.11.15 verification receipts are byte-identical. A dedicated 3.11/3.14 workflow is included; GitHub CI is separate and not claimed green. The proof, source Git-blob bindings, frozen certificate and platform receipts are self-contained.

This is not a universal lower bound, a new finite supplier, an enlarged theorem domain or a κ = 1 proof. The separate 1/33 and Gaussian 1/4 assembly-domain restrictions are already documented upstream and are credited as existing results.

Prepared for chafreaky with OpenAI Codex assistance. Credits: Dugongue #541 static44 construction; icekylinx #535/#531 and the attributed kernel/phase lineage; our #544 admission and owner allocation; Rohan Arun #547 comparison composition; eumemic #543 R420 supplier; the unchanged attributed moment engines. Original notices and licenses remain intact.
